paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Polarity scores for Japan
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the distribution of polarity scores for Japan, comparing the counts of different scores. The x-axis is labeled "Polarity scores" and has a linear scale, ranging from -1.0 to 0.6, with a tick label interval of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled "Counts" and also has a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 40,000, with a tick label interval of 10,000. A single blue line with circular markers and a solid style represents the data, starting at approximately 1,000 counts at a polarity score of -1.1, remaining relatively stable until -0.6 where it increases to around 5,000 counts, then decreases to 3,000 counts at -0.4, followed by a sharp increase to 41,000 counts at 0.0, and then declining to 8,000 counts at 0.1, with subsequent fluctuations to 26,000 counts at 0.2, 2,000 counts at 0.4, and finally decreasing to 1,500 counts at 0.55.
